course_name_en: Advanced Module Knowledge Management and Collaborative Technologies
prerequisites: None. Competencies acquired in the basic modules for Practical Informatics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge and skills in the area of knowledge management and collaborative technologies.
Students know the theoretical principles of knowledge management and collaborative technologies, as well as selected applications.
Students are able to apply working methods from business informatics.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Knowledge management methods in weakly structured data sets
Integration of internal and external corporate information systems

assessment_methods.method: Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments. The final grade is based on a written exam or an individual oral examination, graded on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics program.
